acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein samples were digested using the filter-aided sample preparation method Briefly, 250 μg of each tumor and cell line protein extract dissolved in lysis buffer was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 20 min at 56 °C and alkylated using 50 mM IAA solution for 20 min at 25 °C in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The proteins were digested at 37 °C in wet chamber for 4 h using endoproteinase Lys-C at a 1:50 enzyme-to-protein ratio.
Trypsin (Promega) was added at a 1:50 (enzyme-to-protein ratio) and samples were subjected to a second digestion at 37 °C overnight in wet chamber.

collision_energy.evidence: The normalized collision energy for CID was set at 35%, and supplemental activation for ETD and dynamic exclusion were enabled (exclusion size list: 500; exclusion duration: 40 s).

enrichment_method.evidence: We interrogated the phosphoproteome by enriching the phospho-fraction out of 250 micrograms of purified protein per sample by Ti4-IMAC chromatography coupled with mass-spectrometry.

fragmentation_method.evidence: After the survey scan, the 20 most intense precursors were selected for subsequent decision-tree-based ion trap CID or ETD fragmentation.
